title: Replacing the GitHub runner: SharpAPI is not answering
body: SharpAPI failed 6 checks in a row (unreachable: Could not be reached (Network is unreachable).) and the scans are not getting data from it. The engine restarted its connection and now ends this job after the scan it is on so a new runner (a new address) starts: 1 of 3. After 3 it will switch SharpAPI off and tell you.
